This can make it more difficult to consider alternative moral frameworks or challenge your own assumptions. It's essential to recognize that these factors can both positively and negatively impact your moral development. On one hand, being part of a supportive community can provide a sense of guidance and direction. On the other hand, it's crucial to maintain a critical and open-minded approach to ensure that you're not missing out on valuable insights from other perspectives.
